- name: Task reuse reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.import_tasks: tasks/static.yml
    - ansible.builtin.include_tasks: tasks/dynamic.yml

snippets.title: Tags — ansible-042
snippets.description: Dynamic includes need deliberate tag propagation, such as apply tags or tagging the included tasks. Tagging the include alone is not blanket inheritance.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Tags reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.include_tasks:
        file: tasks/dynamic.yml
        apply:
          tags: [deploy]
      tags: [deploy]

snippets.title: Roles — ansible-043
snippets.description: Role defaults have low variable precedence and are designed for customization. Role vars have higher precedence and are harder for callers to override. The companion role defines service_port in defaults/main.yml and prints its effective value.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Roles reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.include_role:
        name: practice
    # Role defaults/main.yml defines service_port: 8080.
    # Override it in play vars, inventory, or extra vars.

snippets.title: Handlers — ansible-044
snippets.description: listen topics decouple notifications from individual handler names. Multiple handlers can listen to the same topic. The app service is illustrative; syntax QA never restarts a service.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Handlers reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: Configuration changed
      changed_when: true
      notify: app configuration changed
  handlers:
    - name: Restart application service
      listen: app configuration changed
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: app
        state: restarted

snippets.title: Collections — ansible-045
snippets.description: Fully qualified collection names clarify module resolution and reduce collisions with similarly named modules from other collections.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Collections reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: "Hello\n"
        dest: /tmp/practice-message.txt
        mode: "0644"

snippets.title: Host variables — ansible-046
snippets.description: hostvars exposes inventory-host variable contexts. Reading gathered facts from another host still requires those facts to be available.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Host variables reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ hostvars['db1']['service_port'] }}"
    # Inventory must define db1 and service_port; no SSH is triggered.

snippets.title: Task environment — ansible-047
snippets.description: The environment keyword supplies environment variables for task execution. It does not permanently modify the controller or target account’s login configuration.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Task environment reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.command: /usr/bin/printenv APP_MODE
      environment:
        APP_MODE: staging
      register: mode
      changed_when: false
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: mode.stdout

snippets.title: Asynchronous work — ansible-048
snippets.description: poll zero is fire-and-forget behavior for the launching task. Use the returned job information to inspect or wait for completion separately.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Asynchronous work reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/long-job
      async: 600
      poll: 0
      register: job
    # Starting the job does not prove it completed successfully.

snippets.title: Asynchronous work — ansible-049
snippets.description: async_status uses the async job ID to retrieve status. A polling loop with until can wait for its finished result.
snippets.code:
---
- name: Asynchronous work reference
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.command: /opt/app/long-job
      async: 600
      poll: 0
      register: job
    - ansible.builtin.async_status:
        jid: "{{ job.ansible_job_id }}"
